registered_at: 2026-11-16, after the main run (10/16) and BEFORE any held-out conversion; never edited afterwards

prosody.frames: voiced frames where both source and converted are voiced via librosa.pyin, fmin 60, fmax 500, 16 kHz, hop 320

pass_rules.conversion: passes only if all criteria above are met
pass_rules.set: set passes if >=75% of conversions pass and no target has 0 passes

experiment: HELD-OUT: fresh recordings never used in the main set; compares arm A (shipped defaults, f0_preserve=false) with arm B (f0_preserve=true)
pairs: target i (sorted by id) with sources of recordings (i+1) mod 5 and (i+2) mod 5; 10 pairs per arm; identical pairs in both arms
limitation: all five held-out voices are female-range (median F0 177-341 Hz); no male targets, so this cannot speak to the low-F0 failures of the main run
decision_rule: Arm B becomes the recommended default ONLY if pass_rate(B) - pass_rate(A) >= 0.20 AND voice-similarity pass rate of B >= voice-similarity pass rate of A - 0.10. Otherwise the default stays unchanged. This run never alters the registered main-run verdict.
